literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) report the same construct: C-terminal His-tagged NKp30 (NCR3) expressed in NK92 cells. NCR3 is a type I single-pass membrane protein with its ectodomain at residues 19–139 (extracellular) and its C-terminus at residues 161–201 (intracellular, per the authoritative topology landmarks). The C-terminal His tag therefore resides on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line describes a tag at the mature N-terminus (after residue 18), in any extracellular loop, or at any other extracellular position. Because the ledger provides no evidence for an extracellular insertion, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal His tag on full-length NKp30 expressed in NK92 cells; residue 201 (G) is the last residue of the intracellular tail (topology residues 161–201), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
